items.docs:
Returns a list of custom asset attributes. **Note:** A container can have a maximum of 10 custom asset attributes.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Creates a new custom asset attribute.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: attribute_id
params.description: The ID of the custom attribute that you want to update.

items.docs:
Updates the specified custom asset attribute. **Note:** You can only update non-key attributes like `description`.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: attribute_id
params.description: The ID of the custom asset attribute that you want to delete.

items.docs:
Deletes the specified custom asset attribute and removes it from all assets that it's assigned to.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: asset_id
params.description: The ID of the asset you want to list custom asset attributes for.

items.docs:
Returns a list of custom asset attributes assigned to the specified asset. **Note:** A container can have a maximum of 10 custom attributes.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: asset_id
params.description: The ID of the asset for which you want to assign custom asset attributes.

items.docs:
Assigns custom asset attributes to the specified asset.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: asset_id
params.description: The ID of the asset for which you want to remove all custom attributes.

items.docs:
Deletes all custom asset attributes assigned to the specified asset.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: asset_id
params.description: The ID of the asset for which you want to assign a single custom asset attribute.

params.name: attribute_id
params.description: The ID of the custom asset attribute you want to assign to the asset.

items.docs:
Assigns a single custom asset attribute to the specified asset.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: asset_id
params.description: The ID of the asset for which you want to remove a single custom asset attribute.

params.name: attribute_id
params.description: The ID of the custom asset attribute that you want to remove from the asset.

items.docs:
Deletes a single custom asset attribute from the specified asset.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).
